integrity: Proof supplied for every n>=2; exhaustive finite verification for 2<=n<=11 is supplementary rather than a proof of the infinite statement. Source-access risks are stated in the review.
limitations: Ordinary two-rail ladders only; labeled edge-subset count. Previously known general independence-number upper bound is not claimed as new; this classification and enumeration require external literature validation.
title: Three-periodic rigidity of maximum edge open packings in ladder graphs
